_comment: The one model file voice (speech to text, 2.8.0) loads: whisper.cpp's own conversion of large-v3-turbo to q8_0, from the ggerganov/whisper.cpp Hugging Face repo, pinned to a repo revision and checked by size and SHA-256 (the lfs.oid the HF API reports) by scripts/fetch_voice_models.py. Ungated (MIT). MEASURED 2026-11-02 on TheWall's RX 580 (card3, PCI 0000:0c:00.0, Vulkan index 3, 8 GiB) with whisper.cpp v1.9.5 whisper-server built with Vulkan, GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3, 2 threads on CPUs 0,6, DLNE idle, vram sampled every 0.2 s: base 985 MiB (the vision projector); after load 2082 MiB; peak 2083 MiB = +1097 MiB (1.07 GB) above base, steady through 11 s, 30 s and 60 s clips (the model itself is 874 MB plus about 230 MB of compute buffers); load 5.1 s (model file in the page cache); transcription 11 s clip 1.07 s, 30 s clip 2.26 s, 60 s clip 3.71 s (HTTP round trip, warm). Recommended VOICE_MIN_FREE_VRAM_GB = 1.4 (1.07 measured + 0.3 margin, rounded up).
